[{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Bachelor of Music in Jazz Studies Honors","groupId":"fcdf11ee-7781-4521-a7e4-01956340ce4d","position":0,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Students must complete a minimum of 120 units with a Pacific cumulative and program grade point average of 2.0 in order to earn the Bachelor of Music in Jazz Studies (Honors).

","groupId":"c7d2a8ee-69c5-4d3b-a409-01956340ce4d","position":1,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"General Education Requirements","groupId":"42fe1629-85dc-4f6d-abea-01956344212a","position":2,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

For more details, see General Education

Minimum 28 units and 9 courses that include the following requirements.

","groupId":"f72d3b33-d5f2-4c71-9b6c-01956344212a","position":3,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":" CORE Requirements","groupId":"1bcd9a69-0a9e-4f8b-857a-01956345d9d9","position":4,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Notes:

1) CORE Seminars cannot be taken for Pass/No Credit. 

2) Transfer students with 28 or more transfer credits taken after high school are exempt from both CORE seminars.  

","groupId":"239f09a3-d15b-4782-a125-01956345d9d9","position":5,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Breadth Requirement (7 courses, at least 3 units each)","groupId":"36b0cd0e-b9c2-4d10-afa4-019563466806","position":6,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Note:  No more than 2 courses from a single discipline can be used to meet the Breadth Requirement.

","groupId":"3464b0d9-d453-4e08-bb8a-019563466806","position":7,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Diversity and Inclusion Requirement","groupId":"642aa3d0-1254-4cbb-a0cf-01956346d497","position":8,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

All students must complete Diversity and Inclusion coursework (at least 3 units)

Note: Diversity and Inclusion courses can also be used to meet the breadth category requirements, or major or minor requirements.

","groupId":"e8b24dab-c573-4d79-b182-01956346d498","position":9,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":" Fundamental Skills","groupId":"9c6b7caf-74e0-4105-8aaa-0195634b31e8","position":10,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Students must demonstrate competence in:

Writing

Quantitative Analysis (Math)

Note: 1) Failure to satisfy the fundamental skills requirements by the end of four semesters of full-time study at the University is grounds for academic disqualification.

","groupId":"6314bc73-f61c-497c-9f50-0195634b31e8","position":11,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Major Requirements","groupId":"0fdb7785-59b3-41d4-a294-01956377f370","position":12,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Notes:

1) Students are required to take 8 semesters of at least 16 units and up to 32 units of MAPM.

2) Eight units and eight semesters of the MPER, based on placement auditions are required.

3) 18 units of MUJZ are required.

4) 2 units of music electives and maximum 16 units of non-music electives are required.
